name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Purple Reign
description:
Sweet, fruity, and smooth. The Rocket Blast Purple Reign cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Purple Reign brings a bold, grape-forward flavor: sweet purple grape and dark berry notes with a candy-like sweetness and a smooth, mellow finish. It's a rich, taste-forward profile made for easygoing sessions and laid-back evenings.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Purple Reign flavor — sweet grape and dark berry with a candy-like finish
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Sweet flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Purple Reign is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
